start_scene_0_3s.description: ScanWatch display showing nocturnal SpO2 dips below 90%.

core_scene_3_7s.description: Explains link between missing CPAP hours and oxygen desaturation.

end_scene_7_10s.description: Advises wearing CPAP continuously to stabilize oxygen.

en.full_narration: Your watch showed lower nighttime oxygen than usual. Wear your CPAP all night and contact your provider if this pattern continues.

cues.text: Your watch showed lower nighttime oxygen than usual.

fr.full_narration: Votre montre a montré un taux d’oxygène nocturne plus bas que d’habitude. Portez votre CPAP toute la nuit et contactez votre professionnel de santé si cela continue.
